source_caption_text:
Never forget when Snoop Dogg and Wiz Khalifa paid tribute to the rappers we lost too soon 🕊️

When Snoop Dogg and Wiz Khalifa took a moment during their 2023 High School Reunion Tour to honor rappers who passed away too soon, the whole vibe changed. Wiz performed “See You Again” as photos of artists we’ve lost appeared on the big screens. 

The tribute included names like Mac Miller, Nipsey Hussle, Juice WRLD, Pop Smoke, Takeoff and King Von. Seeing so many artists who left their mark on hip-hop remembered in one moment really put into perspective how much the culture has lost.

With thousands of fans singing along, it became more than just another concert moment. Their music is still here, and so are the memories fans have of them. 

#snoopdogg #wizkhalifa #hiphop #seeyouagain
